summary: Resumption and merge from answered blocking Questions (Epic #139 / Feature #148 slice)

entries.migration_impact: When an answer is recorded for a Question that was created as a blocking last-resort (#147), the engine now automatically detects the marker, posts a structured 'Unblocked by answer to Question #N' report on the original Issue (with excerpt + provenance + link), and records the merge action. Enables clean resume of previously paused work. No breaking changes.
entries.agent_notes: Resumption procedure is now detailed in QANDA_CURIOSITY_GUIDANCE. The contemplate() path (triggered from record_answer source=blocking or normal) handles detection + unblock report. Full body mutations and follow-on creation expandable. Use after human answers a blocking Question created via plate_create_blocking_question. Completes the create-pause-answer-resume loop.
